title: Company of Heroes 3
provenance: Reported by sgoger (highball-db#358, 2026-10-06), the Steam copy v5.1.50313.0, Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, D3DMetal, rated 3 of 5. The workaround and causes below are the reporter's; not verified by the maintainer. davidysding (highball-db#631, 2026-10-22), Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, rated 3 of 5 after 9 minutes.
notes: Single-player plays on the Wine 10 engine with D3DMetal, about 50 fps on the Metal HUD at 2560x1440 in the campaign, after a manual fix for a start-up crash. Multiplayer needs Microsoft's ucrtbase.dll: with Wine's own, matches desync. Both fixes are by hand for now; Highball's recipes cannot yet move or copy a game's own files. The reporter found the Wine 11 engine (r19) desyncs the same way, and Steam's window draws black there with Microsoft's ucrtbase, so stay on the Wine 10 engine. A second player on an M5 got it running with the same ucrtbase steps, Advertise AVX, Automatic graphics (D3DMetal for the game) and Synchronization set to None, which cleared a black-screen freeze for them (highball-db#631).

knownIssues.cause: the game folder ships ucrtbase.dll and msvcrt.dll; Wine registers its builtin C runtime under the game folder's path and GetModuleHandle("api-ms-win-crt-heap-l1-1-0.dll") returns NULL (reporter's analysis). A DLL override does not help
knownIssues.fix: move ucrtbase.dll and msvcrt.dll out of the game folder, for example into a backup folder inside it; redo after a game update or a file check

knownIssues.symptom: Multiplayer: "Sync error detected" about 26 seconds into a match
knownIssues.cause: Wine's builtin ucrtbase math differs from Microsoft's, so the lockstep simulation drifts (reporter's analysis; a replay of a Windows match then plays to the end)
knownIssues.fix: copy the game's Microsoft ucrtbase.dll (x86-64) into drive_c/windows/system32 after backing up Wine's, and add the DLL override ucrtbase=n. A live online match was not tested yet

knownIssues.symptom: Crash when leaving a multiplayer match
knownIssues.fix: disable the overlay, for example with the DLL override gameoverlayrenderer64=
